_about: Hand-labelled failures for error analysis. One entry per case_id; updated as we review cases. 'label' = WHAT went wrong (symptom). 'suspected_cause' = WHY (hypothesis until verified).

_label_set.company_mismatch: Retrieved chunks are from a different company's filing
_label_set.year_mismatch: Right company, wrong fiscal year / period
_label_set.right_doc_wrong_page: Right filing retrieved, but not the gold page

_hypotheses.H1_chunk_lacks_context: Chunks after the top of a page don't contain the company name, year or units, so the embedding can't link them to the right company. Status: suspected, not yet verified.
_hypotheses.H2_embedding_model_weak: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 is small and general-purpose: it matches topic ('capex', 'cash flow') well but is weak at telling entities apart (3M vs AMD, 2018 vs 2022), and reads only the first 256 tokens. Status: suspected, not yet verified.
